sanskrit_verse: अनुकूलामवाग्दुष्टां दक्षां साध्वीं प्रजावतीम् । त्यजन्भार्यामवस्थाप्यो राज्ञा दण्डेन भूयसा ॥
transliteration: anukūlām avāgduṣṭāṃ dakṣāṃ sādhvīṃ prajāvatīm | tyajan bhāryām avasthāpyo rājñā daṇḍena bhūyasā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who abandons a wife who is supportive, verbally innocent, capable, virtuous, and fertile must be subjected by the ruler to a greater penalty for violating dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The king derives jurisdiction from Dharma to enforce relational integrity.
Causation: Abandonment disrupts societal continuity and personal dharma.
Capacity-based responsibility: Only one capable of sustaining marital duty incurs liability upon its breach.
Restoration logic: Penalty aims at realigning conduct with dharmic expectations.
Consciousness alignment: Action must reflect awareness of interdependence in social roles.
executable_legal_axioms: IF (person_has_dharmically_accepted_marriage(partner)) AND (abandons_partner(without_just_cause)) AND (partner_exhibits(anukūlā, avākduṣṭā, dakṣā, sādhvī, prajāvatī)) THEN (invoke_kingly_restoration(protocol: 'daṇḍa_bhūyasā'))
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, abandonment of a dharmically aligned spouse invokes royal duty to restore societal harmony through corrective measures that elevate individual consciousness rather than impose punitive suffering.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Through pramāṇa-based discernment, it is established that abandoning a righteous wife creates disorder in varṇa-saṅkarāḥ and breaches familial ṛta. Daṇḍa here functions not as retribution but as sequential correction ensuring future alignment with satya-dharma-anupūrvaśaḥ.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Facilitate reconciliation or conscious severance with full accountability assumed by the abandoning party.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Mandate public acknowledgment and rectification of harm caused to family lineage.
Capacity Restoration: Provide dharmic education and spiritual discipline to prevent recurrence.
Integrity Reintegration: Enforce financial and emotional restitution towards offspring and extended kinship structures.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds from the Supreme Pontiff alone; Dharma stands restored when action aligns with cosmic consciousness, and reality remains ever untouched by punitive delusion.
